name: Snyk Security & Vulnerability Scanning Integration
description: Integration pack for Snyk Security Platform, providing connectivity to Snyk Open Source dependency scanning, Snyk Container image scanning, Snyk Code SAST, Snyk Infrastructure as Code (IaC) misconfiguration audits, and automated PR fix recommendations.

capabilities.name: Security Engineering / Security & Privacy Compliance
capabilities.description: Integrates Snyk Open Source dependency vulnerability checks, container scanning, and Snyk Code SAST. Integrates Snyk license compliance checks (GPL, AGPL risk identification) and IaC security audits.

checklists.name: Snyk Security Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Snyk Service Account API tokens, SCM repository monitoring, and CI vulnerability thresholds.

items.statement: Snyk Service Account API Token authenticates REST API calls and CLI scanner jobs.
Snyk monitors open source dependencies and alerts on newly disclosed CVEs.
Snyk CLI in CI build pipeline fails builds when high/critical vulnerabilities are detected.

reviewGates.name: Snyk DevSecOps Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Security Lead confirms that Snyk vulnerability scans and license compliance checks satisfy security requirements.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Snyk integration verify vulnerability scan triggers and PR fix recommendation delivery?

obligationDefinitions.title: A Snyk-detected vulnerability must be remediated within its severity's SLA
obligationDefinitions.description: A dependency, container, or code vulnerability surfaced by Snyk must be remediated (or waived with an approved, tracked exception) within its severity-based SLA; an untriaged finding sitting in the scan report is not an accepted risk.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every Critical/High Snyk finding is remediated or carries an approved, tracked waiver within its SLA.

requiredEvidence.title: Vulnerability remediation SLA record
requiredEvidence.description: Record of Snyk finding remediation/waiver timing against its severity SLA.
